Lemon & herb pasta

A bright, comforting bowl of pasta with lemon, parsley and a little Parmesan.

Tiempo 20 minutesRaciones 2

Antes de empezar

Ingredientes

Marca los ingredientes a medida que avanzas.

Lo que necesitarás

  • large pot
  • frying pan

Manos a la obra

Pasos

1

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta (200 g) and cook for 10 minutes, or according to the package.

2

Meanwhile, warm olive oil (2 tbsp) in a frying pan. Add garlic (2 cloves) (finely chopped) and cook gently for 1 minute.

3

Drain the pasta, reserving a small cup of the cooking water. Add it to the pan with lemon juice (2 tbsp) and Parmesan (40 g) (grated). Toss with a splash of the reserved water until glossy.

4

Finish with parsley (1 handful) (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

Buena comida. Ingredientes simples. Algo que merece ser compartido.Hecho con Cooklang.
